verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party LoRA documentation says users can upload their existing LoRA adapters and run inference with them on Groq infrastructure. That covers both the upload and the serving halves of the story through its LoRA branch. missing for 10: upload of full custom model weights, details on supported base models, limits and access requirements for LoRA hosting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Upload your existing LoRA adapters to run specialized inference while maintaining the performance and efficiency of Groq's infrastructure.
